entities.name: Treatise on Astrology of the Kaiyuan Era
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Great Tang Treatise on Astrology of the Kaiyuan Era, also called the Kaiyuan Star Observations, is a Chinese astrology encyclopedia compiled by Gautama Siddha and a team of scholars between 714 and 724 AD during the Kaiyuan era of the Tang dynasty.
